text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Umm, why did you two call me out here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~... Welcome, birthday girl Top 
Road-chan!

text_block_list.name: Urara & Rice
text_block_list.text:
To the Top Road Fan Club! To the Top 
Road-san Fan Club!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here's the cheering dance I practiced with 
Rice-chan! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Urara & Rice
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray! Top Road-san! Go, go, Top 
Road-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um, what on earth... is this...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Well... Top Road-san is always 
carrying everyone's hopes and doing her 
best, so—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We'll do our best cheering for you too! 
Forever and ever, as long as you keep 
giving it your all, Top Road-chan, we'll 
keep cheering with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, yes! Thank you very much, both 
of you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone wishes and cheers for 
me— I will keep running along this path!
